sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the maintenance 
procedure P1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the title block.

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Hussein Hashem Mohamed, tested by eng. Naser El Sayed Abd 
EL-Aziz, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed Osama Soliman Selim, 
approved by eng. 
Mohamed Abdel-Baset head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control 
general director.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc

Isolate the generator out of 
 service

The generator circuit breaker is 
 switched off

The generator field breaker is 
 switched off

The field flashing AC and DC are 
 switched off

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check and clean excitation 
transformer components.

Check and clean the 
cooling fans of thyristor and their alarm system.

Check and clean the 
equipment of the thyristor pannels using comprissed air.

Clean the air filter of 
thyristor pannels using compressed air

Check gate terminal of the 
thyristor with the aid of special marrior to ensure the proper terminal 
connrction.

Check and clean auto 
voltage regulator component.

Check and clean filed 
breaker contacts and measure the clearance between moving contact and fixed 
contact and readjust it if necessary.

Check and clean the 
discharge resistance contacts and measure the clearance between moving contact 
and fixed contact and readjust it if necessary.

Check and clean field 
flashing breaker contact.

Check all fuses for 
Thyristors.

Check and test excitation 
over current relay (two stages).

Check all protection 
signals for excitation system with the unit control board.

Operate the field breaker 
(ON - OFF) for test while checking the performance of the discharge resistance 
contact synchronising with the main field breaker contacts operation.
